about: Hand-written assumption table. Each row names what the protocol treats as proven, the spec rule, and the check evidence that would satisfy each required property. build_gaps.py matches these against inputs.json.

spec_sources.Rev 6: Vinculum_Finalis_Requirement_Traceability.csv (the Rev 6 docx is not in the repo) and src/lib/vfRevision6Authority.js

assumptions.input: EVM block header + sourceFinalityProof (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche)
assumptions.assumed: The header is part of the source chain's settled (finalized) history, on the named chain

required.property: header anchored to settled history (light client, checkpoint, validator signatures or confirmations)
chain id read from chain data, not from the caller's claim

assumptions.gap: Only keccak(header) == claimed hash, claimed height == header number, and claimed chain id == the reader's own constant. The claimed chain id is the caller's word; an Ethereum header carries no chain id. Nothing ties the header to any real chain. EthereumLockReader (beacon light client) exists but the ceremony registers SimpleEthereumLockReader; the checkers/ finality contracts are never called by any reader.
assumptions.exploit: Run a local fork, create a real-looking lock, then rewrite header fields (mixHash, parentHash) so the header exists on no chain; the receipt proof still matches its receiptsRoot. Submit with claimed chain id 1. Known Oct 22 finding (non_base_finality_trust_model.test.cjs): about 311 VCLM per forged lock.
assumptions.damage: Unlimited VCLM mint up to the 500,000,000 hard cap, and CHONX after activation, with no real asset locked. Inflated supply also inflates RAC and stake rewards.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-XCH-006/008: no issuance before documented exact finality; relayer cannot waive finality. Code accepts a self-consistent header with no finality at all. Mitigation in config only: commit 5a21665 says the live Base ceremony is Base-only until settled-history checkers exist; build_ceremony_artifacts.cjs still ships these readers.

assumptions.input: UTXO block header + sourceFinalityProof (Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Litecoin, Dogecoin, DigiByte, Zcash)
assumptions.assumed: The header carries real proof of work, links to the best chain, and has enough confirmations

required.property: proof of work meets the header's target
linked to a known chain (prev hash / checkpoint)
confirmation depth

assumptions.gap: Only double-SHA256(header) == claimed hash and claimed height == coinbase height. No target check, no parent link, no confirmations. BitcoinHeaderChecker and ZcashHeaderChecker exist but are not called.
assumptions.exploit: Build an 80-byte header with any prev hash, bits 0x1d00ffff and any nonce over a merkle root that includes a self-made lock transaction to the Dev Fund script; no mining needed. PoC AG-02 shows verifyFinality and extractFacts accept it.
assumptions.damage: Unlimited VCLM/CHONX mint from fabricated Bitcoin-family locks, valued at the registry price of BTC, LTC, etc.

assumptions.input: Stellar ledger header and XRPL ledger header
assumptions.assumed: The ledger was closed by the network (SCP quorum for Stellar, UNL validator signatures for XRPL)

required.property: quorum or validator signatures over the ledger
linked to a trusted ledger

assumptions.gap: Only hash(header) == claimed hash and claimed sequence/index == header field. Any self-built ledger header is accepted.
assumptions.exploit: Build a ledger header whose tx-set or account-state hash commits to a fabricated payment to the Dev Fund account with a chosen memo; any previous-ledger/parent hash. PoC AG-03a/03b.
assumptions.damage: Unlimited VCLM/CHONX mint from fabricated XLM/XRP locks.

assumptions.assumed: Fail closed until a Solana proof exists
assumptions.gap: None. The reader always reverts.
assumptions.damage: none

assumptions.assumed: The lock exists in the Base lock contract and its binding payload matches

required.property: lock record exists

assumptions.gap: None for finality: same-chain state read.
assumptions.damage: none

assumptions.assumed: One RAC per real fee payment; racIdentity is derived from the lock's immutable facts

required.property: racIdentity derived from proven lock facts
at most one RAC per lock

assumptions.gap: The only check is !recordedRacs[racIdentity]. racIdentity is free caller input, so the same proven lock can record RAC any number of times, before or after it mints.
assumptions.exploit: Create one real Base lock (about $2.39 in the PoC). Call recordFeeAndRac K times with K random racIdentity values. epochRewardBasis grows K times; allocateEpoch mints basis*10 VCLM to stakers. PoC: 50 records paid 358.8 VCLM of stake rewards versus 7.176 honest.
assumptions.damage: Stake reward VCLM inflated without bound (until the VCLM cap), diluting every holder; attacker who stakes captures it. Works today on the Base-only ceremony.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-FEE-011 note: RAC keyed by immutable-facts identity (Section D); VF-RAC-001 exact-once. Code keys RAC on a caller-chosen value.

assumptions.assumed: Valuation Timestamp equals the finalized source block timestamp (lock creation time)

required.property: equal to the proven creation time

assumptions.gap: valuationTimestamp is never compared with the reader's createdAt; any value <= launch gives day-0 emission.
assumptions.exploit: Mint at day 400 with valuationTimestamp = 0. PoC: 310.96 VCLM instead of 249.92 for the same lock (24% more); the gap grows as decay continues.
assumptions.damage: Emission decay is defeated for every lock; total issuance runs faster toward the cap.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-ORC-011/013. src/lib/vfComplianceData.js:156 marks VF-ORC-011 IMPLEMENTED.

assumptions.input: lock reference price (scheduledPrices at first submission)
assumptions.assumed: The reference price is the last successful run at lock creation and is retained for that lock

required.property: price selected by lock creation time

assumptions.gap: The price is bound at the first recordFeeAndRac/verifyAndMint, using whatever run is current then. Lock time is not consulted. The submitter picks the moment.
assumptions.exploit: Lock when the asset is cheap, wait for a higher run, then submit. PoC: price up 10x between lock and submission gives 3109.6 VCLM instead of 310.96.
assumptions.damage: Free option on price: up to the full price move per lock; systematic over-issuance.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-ORC-009/010. vfComplianceData.js:154 marks VF-ORC-009 IMPLEMENTED with trace 'at verification time', which is the gap itself.

assumptions.assumed: Prices come from the twice-daily scheduled run; a record is valid until the next run; the poster has no value authority

required.property: bounded price change or second source
run timestamp / staleness
runId advances by a bounded step

assumptions.gap: Only poster identity, runId > last, price > 0. No bound, no timestamp, no staleness. runId = 2^64-1 freezes all later runs forever (prices can never update or be marked failed).
assumptions.exploit: A compromised or mistaken poster posts 1000x price and mints from a tiny lock; or posts runId 2^64-1 to freeze prices. PoC: a 0.001 ETH lock minted 31,096 VCLM.
assumptions.damage: Unlimited mint via price; permanent price freeze (stale prices used forever, VF-ORC-008 violated).
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-ORC-008 (stale record used), VF-SEC-005 (poster gets value authority).

assumptions.assumed: The fee went to the configured Dev Fund for that environment

required.property: fee destination equals devFundDestinations[env]

assumptions.gap: The Dev Fund check is commented out ('In simulation: skip'). devFundDestinations is written by configureDevFund but never read at mint; the reader/lock Dev Fund is never compared with it.
assumptions.exploit: Register (or point at) a lock whose devFund is the attacker; fee goes back to the attacker, mint still succeeds. PoC AG-09: verifier Dev Fund set to one address, lock fee to another, mint succeeds with junk devFundDestination and zero evidence.
assumptions.damage: Fees can bypass the Dev Fund while still earning issuance and RAC; makes the fee cost of an attack zero when combined with a misconfigured or forged source.

assumptions.input: ERC20 lock token balance over time (rebasing)
assumptions.assumed: Token balances held by the lock do not change on their own

required.property: rebasing token rejected or share accounting

assumptions.gap: Inbound fee-on-transfer is handled (balance delta). Rebasing is not: one shared pool, fixed principal per lock. Negative rebase makes the last releasers insolvent; positive rebase is stuck. Fee to Dev Fund uses transfer(fee) with no received check. No on-chain rebasing reject in the registry.
assumptions.exploit: If any rebasing token is registered on a non-Base chain, a negative rebase shifts the loss to whoever releases last.
assumptions.damage: Loss of principal for late releasers of that token; depends on registry content.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-SEC-001 requires rejection of rebasing assets unless handled.

assumptions.assumed: Fee and principal are computed on the amount actually received

required.property: received amount measured as a balance delta (not a guard, so matched in the function body)

assumptions.gap: None.
assumptions.damage: none

assumptions.input: lockId in UTXO / Stellar / XRPL payload
assumptions.assumed: A lockId names exactly one lock and only its creator can use it

required.property: lockId derived from the transaction (txid, sender)

assumptions.gap: lockId is read from the payload the creator writes. Anyone can make a real (small) lock with a victim's announced lockId and mint first; consumedLocks then blocks the victim.
assumptions.exploit: Watch the mempool for a lock payload, make a cheap lock with the same lockId, submit first.
assumptions.damage: Victim's lock can never mint (griefing); principal still releases.

assumptions.assumed: Every USDC/USDT row is caught by the $0.95 rule

required.property: stablecoin flag stored per registry row

assumptions.gap: Detection is by symbol shape (USDC, USDT, USDC_x, USDT_x, USDTE). A row named USDbC, USDC.e or USDT.e is not caught, so the $0.95 floor does not apply to it.
assumptions.exploit: During a depeg, a lock of an unmatched stablecoin row is valued at the depegged run without the floor rule (the floor exists to block that).
assumptions.damage: Limited to the depeg size on those rows.

assumptions.input: app finality proof fields (finalityStatus, l1Finalized, challengePeriodPassed, confirmations)
assumptions.assumed: The app only shows 'verified' when the chain says so

required.property: independent chain query (RPC/light client)

assumptions.gap: The app verifier trusts self-reported status fields in the proof object; BaseVerifier page builds mock events and takes a typed 'Verified Gross USD'; ChainVerifierPanel says finality is verified by the chain verifier (false per AG-01..03); vfComplianceData marks VF-XCH-008, VF-ORC-009, VF-ORC-011 IMPLEMENTED; 'verified' USD is an off-chain quote.
assumptions.exploit: Not an on-chain loss by itself; misleads users and reviewers about what is proven.
assumptions.damage: Wrong status shown to users; compliance table hides AG-01, AG-05, AG-06.
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 13 section 5 already flags vfComplianceData as wrong for ITS rows (those rows are now fixed); other rows remain wrong.

assumptions.assumed: Package precision matches the registry before RAC is credited

required.property: precision equals registry decimals

assumptions.gap: Only verifyAndMint checks precision. RAC uses entry.decimals so the value is right, but VF-XCH-011 binding of asset_precision is not enforced on the RAC path.
assumptions.damage: none found (binding gap only)
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 6 VF-XCH-011 lists asset_precision as a bound field.

assumptions.input: UTXO lock time and maturity (miner-set time)
assumptions.assumed: Duration on a UTXO chain equals the chosen duration

required.property: exact duration

assumptions.gap: Maturity may differ from duration by up to TOLERANCE_SECS (1 day) of blocks; createdAt is the miner-set header time.
assumptions.exploit: Lock slightly shorter than the multiplier tier implies.
assumptions.damage: Up to 1 day less commitment per lock.

assumptions.input: createdAt from non-Base readers for the CHONX causal check
assumptions.assumed: Source creation time is real chain time

required.property: source time anchored

assumptions.gap: createdAt comes from the header the caller supplies (miner/validator-set time, unanchored per AG-01..03); the 1-day margin only covers honest clock skew.
assumptions.exploit: With AG-01..03, set the header time after activation; without them, a source-chain clock skew under 1 day.
assumptions.damage: CHONX eligibility for a lock made before activation.

assumptions.assumed: USD value used for the lock band gate is real

required.property: USD derived from a price source

assumptions.gap: The lock trusts the caller's USD for its band gate. The Verifier recomputes USD for issuance, so this only affects which band the lock lets through.
assumptions.exploit: Pass a USD inside the band for an out-of-band lock; Verifier then rejects issuance, user pays fee for nothing (self-harm).
assumptions.damage: Low; user self-harm.

assumptions.input: registry rows and token address index
assumptions.assumed: Each row's decimals and token address are the real token's

required.property: on-chain identity check (decimals/code) or signed registry hash

assumptions.gap: Rows are written by the deployer before finalize from the off-chain build; nothing checks them on chain. A wrong decimals value mis-values every lock of that asset.
assumptions.exploit: Operator error or a tampered registry build (deployer-only, pre-finalize).
assumptions.damage: Mis-valuation of one asset for the protocol's lifetime (immutable).

assumptions.assumed: The reader registered for 'Ethereum' reads Ethereum

required.property: reader ENVIRONMENT_ID equals the name

assumptions.gap: Any non-zero address is accepted for any name. With AG-01, an EVM reader also accepts a testnet lock at the same CREATE address (same deployer key and nonce) because the chain id is only claimed.
assumptions.exploit: Deploy the lock on a testnet with the mainnet deployer nonce, lock test ETH, mint as mainnet.
assumptions.damage: Mint from worthless testnet assets (same root cause as AG-01).

assumptions.input: msg.sender on VCLM/CHONX mint and initialize
assumptions.assumed: Only the Verifier and the Stake mint; set once; no new minter (Rev 13)

required.property: minter gate

assumptions.gap: None.
assumptions.damage: none
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 13: no new minter; code agrees.

assumptions.assumed: An epoch closes only after it ends

required.property: epoch end reached

assumptions.gap: None found (Base time).
assumptions.damage: none

assumptions.assumed: (comment) token locks revert

required.property: behaviour matches comment

assumptions.gap: The comment says token locks revert; code returns keccak(abi.encode('Base', token)), resolved through tokenAssetIndex. Stale comment; the code path is the intended one.
assumptions.damage: none (documentation)

assumptions.assumed: (Rev 12) no Handshake allowance limit; no identity counter

required.property: field removed or ignored

assumptions.gap: The Verifier still requires the package to state 3 (EVM/Base) or 1 (UTXO/Stellar/XRPL) from the Rev 6 allowance rule. It counts nothing, so no limit applies, but the Rev 6 field is still a required input.
assumptions.damage: none (vestige; a wrong value only makes a mint revert)
assumptions.rev_conflict: Rev 12 removes the allowance; Verifier still enforces the Rev 6 constant.

assumptions.input: Ethereum header via beacon light client (EthereumLockReader, control row)
assumptions.assumed: The header is in finalized Ethereum history

required.property: header anchored to settled history (light client, checkpoint, validator signatures or confirmations)

assumptions.gap: None at the reader (control row: shows the AG-01 rule passes a reader that has an anchor). Note: this reader is not the one the ceremony registers.
assumptions.damage: none
